capabilities: list notes sharing tags with the active note
group and sort results by tag or title
filter by minimum tag matches, excluded tags, and excluded folders
show note titles, content excerpts, and matched tags
search the listed notes and open them in tabs or previews
extras: The preview-on-hover feature requires the core Page preview plugin to be enabled. Versions after 0.7.1 require Obsidian v1.13.0 or newer.
motivation: The README says heavy tag users want tags to be more useful, and note takers with generic titles (Zettelkasten, atomic notes) need excerpts to recognize related notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view for finding notes related to the current note through shared tags, which makes tags less useful for discovery.
summary: Sidebar panel that lists notes sharing tags with the currently active note, with sorting, match filters, excerpts, and search.
